data.body:
AC amendment (gap-analysis: missing_error_path): Guarantee cleanup of all 7 created tickets even on mid-run failure.

Amend ab56 so the integration test registers each created ticket ID for cleanup immediately after creation (append to a CLEANUP array) and runs 'ticket delete <id> --user-approved' for every registered ID in an EXIT/ERR trap, NOT only on the happy path. The trap must fire before the script exits non-zero on a failed assertion. Without this, a mid-loop assertion failure leaves orphan CLI_user/detected_by:* tickets in .tickets-tracker/ polluting subsequent runs and validate-issues.sh health scores.

Additional verify step: grep -q 'trap' tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh && grep -qE 'ticket delete.*--user-approved' tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh
